tools.name: polar_list_organizations
tools.description: List the organisations the token can act for. Start here — most other tools take an organization_id. Polar: GET /v1/organizations/.

tools.name: polar_list_products
tools.description: List products, optionally filtered by archived state, recurrence or a text query. Polar: GET /v1/products/.

tools.name: polar_get_product
tools.description: Fetch a single product with its prices and attached benefits. Polar: GET /v1/products/{id}.

tools.name: polar_list_customers
tools.description: List customers, optionally by email or a text query. Polar: GET /v1/customers/.

tools.name: polar_get_customer
tools.description: Fetch a single customer by Polar id. Polar: GET /v1/customers/{id}.

tools.name: polar_get_customer_state
tools.description: Fetch everything about one customer in a single call — active subscriptions, granted benefits and entitlements. The best answer to 'what does this customer currently have?'. Polar: GET /v1/customers/{id}/state.

tools.name: polar_get_customer_state_by_external_id
tools.description: Same as polar_get_customer_state, but looked up by YOUR external id rather than Polar's — the usual path when you hold your own user id. Polar: GET /v1/customers/external/{external_id}/state.

tools.name: polar_list_orders
tools.description: List orders, filtered by customer, product, subscription, status or a date window. Polar: GET /v1/orders/.

tools.name: polar_get_order
tools.description: Fetch a single order with its line items, discount and tax. Polar: GET /v1/orders/{id}.

tools.name: polar_list_subscriptions
tools.description: List subscriptions, filtered by customer, product, status, active state or cancellation window. Polar: GET /v1/subscriptions/.

tools.name: polar_get_subscription
tools.description: Fetch a single subscription with its product, price and period. Polar: GET /v1/subscriptions/{id}.

tools.name: polar_get_metrics
tools.description: Fetch revenue and subscription metrics over a date range, bucketed by interval — orders, revenue, MRR, active subscriptions. Polar: GET /v1/metrics/.

tools.name: polar_list_benefits
tools.description: List benefits — the things a product grants, such as licence keys, file downloads or Discord roles. Polar: GET /v1/benefits/.

tools.name: polar_list_benefit_grants
tools.description: List who has been granted one benefit, and whether the grant is still active. Polar: GET /v1/benefits/{id}/grants.

tools.name: polar_list_discounts
tools.description: List discount codes and their redemption limits. Polar: GET /v1/discounts/.

tools.name: polar_list_refunds
tools.description: List refunds, filtered by order, subscription, customer or success. Polar: GET /v1/refunds/.

tools.name: polar_list_license_keys
tools.description: List issued licence keys and their status. Polar: GET /v1/license-keys/.

tools.name: polar_list_meters
tools.description: List the usage meters that aggregate events into billable quantities. Polar: GET /v1/meters/.

tools.name: polar_get_meter_quantities
tools.description: Fetch the aggregated quantities a meter has recorded over a window — what usage-based billing will charge for. Polar: GET /v1/meters/{id}/quantities.

tools.name: polar_list_events
tools.description: List the raw usage events ingested for metering, filtered by customer, meter, name or time. Polar: GET /v1/events/.

tools.name: polar_list_webhook_deliveries
tools.description: List webhook delivery attempts with their HTTP results — the tool for 'why did my webhook not arrive?'. Polar: GET /v1/webhooks/deliveries.

tools.name: polar_list_webhook_endpoints
tools.description: List the configured webhook endpoints and their subscribed events. Polar: GET /v1/webhooks/endpoints.

tools.name: polar_redeliver_webhook_event
tools.description: Queue one webhook event for redelivery after your endpoint recovered. Polar: POST /v1/webhooks/events/{id}/redeliver.

tools.name: polar_create_refund
tools.description: Refund an order, in full or in part. This moves real money back to the customer. Polar: POST /v1/refunds/.

tools.name: polar_cancel_subscription
tools.description: Cancel a subscription at the end of its current period. The customer keeps access until then. Polar: PATCH /v1/subscriptions/{id}.

tools.name: polar_create_checkout_link
tools.description: Create a reusable checkout URL for one or more products — the link you put in a page or an email. Polar: POST /v1/checkout-links/.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: polar_list_customers · Private data: polar_list_organizations, polar_list_benefits · Public sink: polar_list_customers, polar_list_webhook_deliveries, polar_list_webhook_endpoints, polar_redeliver_webhook_event, polar_create_refund, polar_create_checkout_link.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: polar_list_customers · Private data: polar_list_organizations, polar_list_benefits · Public sink: polar_list_customers, polar_list_webhook_deliveries, polar_list_webhook_endpoints, polar_redeliver_webhook_event, polar_create_refund, polar_create_checkout_link

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
